About Us

KD Express Laundry is a modern laundry service focused on making garment care fast, convenient and stress-free. We provide professional washing, ironing, packaging and delivery, with your clothes handled with care.

Our 24-hour service sets us apart. From washing to ironing, packaging and delivery, we get your clothes fresh and ready in under 24 hours.
